findings.description: New policy evaluation dispatch layer with admission priority override. Unverified admission is forced to Denied at Admission layer; Emergency overlay has highest priority. Policy decision persisted before returning.
New shard policy decision port. Validates ticket ownership, computes overflow-safe next sequence, reserves capacity, calls journal strict port, updates sequence only after success.

New 3-phase recovery admission validation. Phase A: validate command admission evidence. Phase B: validate checkpoint policy pin. Phase C: build unverified admission for legacy recovery. All validation before state mutation.
Added RecoveredAdmissionKind enum (Historical vs Unverified). RecoverRunCommand carries admission evidence. Public 7-arg new() and for_retry() preserved.
MAX_FUZZ_PAYLOAD_USIZE increased from 4096 to 100,000 to match actual prepush bound. Regression test validates >4096 events and <=100,000 bound.
New append_policy_decision_strict trait method with fail-closed default. StorageRuntimeJournal and QueuedStorageRuntimeJournal implement it.
execute_registered_action evaluates policy before adapter execution. reconcile_registered_action skips policy (recovery-only). New PolicyDenied error variant.
